claims.assertion: Za’el suggests unresolved trauma may originate in childhood, later experiences, or past lives, within his non-linear model of time.
claims.speaker: Za’el de Erra
claims.qualifiers: He presents multiple explanations as possibilities for individuals to assess.

claims.assertion: Za’el describes an “inner child” as a persistent aspect of consciousness associated with past hurt; he says thought patterns shape the unconscious and can be addressed through shadow work.
claims.speaker: Za’el de Erra
claims.qualifiers: This is his proposed self-reflection framework.
